part.text:
Fixed the header injection risk and added regression coverage.

## Change: `src/context.ts:772-781`
The `Location` value is now post-processed to percent-encode raw CR and LF after the existing multibyte handling, so:

```ts
(!/[^\x00-\xFF]/.test(locationString) ? locationString : encodeURI(locationString))
  .replace(/\r/g, '%0D')
  .replace(/\n/g, '%0A')
```

- Raw `\r` → `%0D`, raw `\n` → `%0A`, blocking `Set-Cookie`/header injection through `Location`.
- Already-percent-encoded input (`%0D%0A`) contains no raw CR/LF, so it is left intact (no double-encoding).
- Multibyte paths still go through `encodeURI` as before, and the status code/default 302 behavior is untouched.

## Tests: `src/context.test.ts:132-159`
- Raw `\r\n`, lone `\r`, and lone `\n` payloads are encoded, status stays 302, and no injected `Set-Cookie` header appears.
- Encoding preserves the caller-supplied status (`301`).
- Percent-encoded `%0D%0A` input is preserved verbatim.

## Verification
`pnpm exec vp test --run src/context.test.ts` → **66 tests passed (1 file)**, `context.ts` at 100% branch coverage. (ESLint isn't installed in this repo, so no lint run.)

Changes are unstaged; diff shown above for review.
